Synopsis:
    Peru is in the final stretch of FTA negotiations with India, now its second-largest export destination driven by gold shipments, with a deal signing targeted for 2027. Peru also expects record exports exceeding $100B in 2026. US tariffs introduced in July are pressuring Peruvian agricultural exports (blueberries, grapes, avocados, textiles), and Lima is actively seeking relief through diplomatic channels, including upcoming UN General Assembly talks with Washington.
